headline: Magic Carpet flies on the GPU
lede: Session 23 resumed the half-built MAGIC CARPET HD corpse, root-caused why the world was invisible, and shipped the fresh WebGL2 renderer: live-heightmap terrain that visibly craters under you, shader water and skies, GPU fire and lightning, and bloom — rules untouched.

notes.text: MAGIC CARPET HD shipped (#1083, PR #1089): terrain heights sampled in the vertex shader from a live RGBA8 map re-uploaded every tick, so blasts tear the ground and low craters flood; per-world skies, water with glitter and shore foam, instanced fire/smoke, jagged lightning, bright-pass bloom.

Corpse autopsied: the camera-centered terrain grid subtracted its half-span twice, stranding the camera 288u outside its own world — only the sky dome rendered. Found by rendering terrain alone with a red debug material and splitting shader vs geometry, not by staring at the black frame.

carpetcheck 30->44 gates. The load-bearing new one digs a hot crater ahead of the carpet and demands the near ground light up — the proven-fail mutant is the corpse bug itself: reintroduce the double-offset and it goes red while every sim gate stays green. Also fixed: tap-to-start (pointer listeners sat on the pointer-events:none HUD canvas).
Polish pass filed for QA: #1090 (water shimmer, animated entities, cloud parallax, fire tongues, iPhone ladder).
